description: Reviewed, intentional changes to protected production files. A protected file that differs from the validated baseline is accepted only when BOTH its baseline hash and its current hash match an entry here; any other edit still makes a test INVALID. Add an entry only after the change's tests pass.

changes.title: hold-and-resume default (stale_resume_s = 2 s), actuator-model stop reporting, and sensor results received on a separate thread
changes.summary: Adds hold-and-resume as the default freshness-watchdog response. The trip is unchanged: zero velocity at the same moment and image age. With stale_resume_s > 0 (default 2 s) the alignment is paused, resumes on the next fresh frame, and ends as stale_camera only if none arrives within stale_resume_s. stale_resume_s = 0 restores the original stop exactly. Adds counters watchdog_pauses, watchdog_resumes, paused_s, paused_motion_ticks and pause/resume events. Rationale and evidence: docs/WATCHDOG_DECISION.md. 2026-09-30: stop/pause/shutdown pass their reason to Simulation.command_velocity; stop, pause and resume events record a command_serial; RealtimeSession(actuator=...) selects the actuator profile; report() adds 'actuator', 'motion' and 'motion_evicted'. Watchdog logic and timing are unchanged. 2026-10-01: the report adds 'safety' (Simulation.safety_record); RuntimeConfig.inference_failure injects failed perception results for fault injection (default 0, inert); a negative control gap (clock stepped back) is integrated as zero instead of crashing after the clock_error stop, a defect found by the fault-injection campaign. 2026-10-02: sensor results are received on a separate thread (ResultReceiver): it is the only reader of the results pipe and forwards whole messages to a one-item, latest-wins mailbox that the control loop reads without blocking. This fixes the defect found by the fault-injection campaign: a worker killed in the middle of sending a frame left a partial message that blocked the control thread (and with it the watchdog and the deadline checks). The control loop still detects a dead worker with is_alive() and stops with worker_failed; the parent closes its copy of the pipe's send end so a half-read message ends with EOF; shutdown joins the receiver for at most 0.5 s and records it in report()["receiver"]. Sensor rows add receiver_s; received_s keeps its meaning; counts add receiver_dropped. A failing receiver delivers its error even over an unread message; the worker's final error message uses a 1 s bounded put instead of put_latest so its traceback is not dropped while the receiver holds the read lock. Messages, the worker and the watchdog logic are unchanged. Timing before and after: results/receiver-thread/20261002-timing.

changes.title: actuator dynamics between command and servo; physical stop measurement
changes.summary: Adds the simulated actuator dynamics model (actuator.py, actuator_config.json; docs/ACTUATOR_MODEL.md) between the guarded velocity command and MuJoCo's velocity servos: acceleration, deceleration and jerk limits; profile 'ideal' passes the command through unchanged. Every stop, hold, collision block and shutdown still zeroes the command at the same moment; the physical braking that follows is measured (Simulation.motion_log). The joint-limit backstop now triggers earlier by the remaining stopping distance (zero with 'ideal'). command_velocity() takes an optional stop reason. velocity_command keeps its meaning. 2026-10-01: records the safety envelope on every physics step (minimum clearance slack from the guard, minimum joint margin, peak commanded and measured speed); no decision depends on it.

changes.title: new: actuator dynamics model
changes.summary: Adds the simulated actuator dynamics model (actuator.py, actuator_config.json; docs/ACTUATOR_MODEL.md) between the guarded velocity command and MuJoCo's velocity servos: acceleration, deceleration and jerk limits; profile 'ideal' passes the command through unchanged. Every stop, hold, collision block and shutdown still zeroes the command at the same moment; the physical braking that follows is measured (Simulation.motion_log). Rejects a profile that brakes slower than the collision guard's braking_time_s assumes.

changes.title: new: actuator profiles (ideal, default, gentle)
changes.summary: Assumed limits, not drive data: default 2 rad/s^2 acceleration, 5 rad/s^2 deceleration, 150 rad/s^3 jerk; standstill below 0.001 rad/s for 20 ms; servo lag allowance 15 ms.

changes.title: keep the smallest clearance slack of each check for the safety record
changes.summary: filter_velocity() stores the smallest distance above its margin (last_slack, last_slack_pair) from the distances it already computes. Used only for the recorded safety envelope (REQ-11); no guard decision changes.
